Message.Name: Market Data Trade Message
Message.Description: Generated each time a trade has been performed in the Electronic, Inter Office or Ring venues. When an incoming order matches against multiple resting orders there is one Market Data Trade published for each matched trade.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time at which the trade occurred.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue on which the trade was executed.

Field.Name: MatchedTime
Field.Description: Time the trade was matched in LMEsmart. Null until such time.

Field.Name: RingSession
Field.Description: This identifies the ring trading session. Space if not applicable.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the trade. For TaS and TaR either the differential or the substituted price. Null for a strategy from a non-electronic venue. Implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Trade volume. Null for a strategy from a non-electronic venue.

Field.Name: MatchID
Field.Description: Assigned trade match identifier for the matched trade.

Field.Name: TradeAtReferencePriceType
Field.Description: For a TaR, indicates whether the price is differential or substituted. Defaults to space, meaning not applicable.

Field.Name: RemainingRecords
Field.Description: Number of leg records still to be published for this trade.

Field.Name: RecordCount
Field.Description: The number of leg records carried by this message.

Field.Name: StrategyLegCount
Field.Description: Number of legs of the strategy.

Field.Name: Trade Legs
Field.Description: One entry per leg record carried by this message, counted by RecordCount.
